description: This file defines functions for rendering 2D quadrilaterals with fill and stroke styles using OpenGL. It includes functions for drawing filled quads, stroked quads, and a composite function that combines both based on color visibility, utilizing external OpenGL functions and custom helper functions.

methods.description: Renders a filled quadrilateral with specified vertex positions and color.

methods.description: Renders the outline of a quadrilateral with specified vertex positions, stroke weight, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_quad(lua_Number x1,lua_Number y1,lua_Number x2,lua_Number y2,lua_Number x3,lua_Number y3,lua_Number x4,lua_Number y4,lua_Number strokeWeight,lu5_color fill,lu5_color stroke)
methods.description: Composite function that renders a filled and/or stroked quadrilateral based on the visibility of the fill and stroke colors.
